propositions: ADR 0035 §(d) lacks concrete specification of backend interface, blocking decomposition and plan-review of implementation stories S2–S5
rebar's local ticket model is canonical; no separate CanonicalTicket type; adapters translate vendor↔local via existing mappers (outbound_fields.py, inbound_fields.py, inbound_translate.py)

backend interface is exposed via five role Protocols (TicketTransport, OutboundMapper, InboundMapper, FieldSanitizer, IdentityConvention) plus optional capability Protocols, unified under one Backend facade
RemoteRef type {vendor, instance, remote_id} replaces hardcoded vendor literals and bare vendor_key throughout apply_inbound_records.py and related code
core layer owns diff/apply logic; adapter layer only reads and enacts; three existing leaks (ADF-sizing, lossy-status/parent rules, duplicated value-maps/link-constants) must be fixed
